name: ICE manipulator
full_name: Siemens Healthineers robotic ICE catheter manipulator (proximal and distal units)
group: Siemens Healthineers Digital Technology & Innovation (Y.-H. Kim, A. Kapoor, T. Mansi) with Houston Methodist (C. H. Lin, Z. Li) and Texas A&M (R. Langari, zero-slack design)
versions: 2020 arXiv (kim2020_towards: 'Back' unit on the handle turns both knobs and gives bulk rotation, 'Front' unit at the introducer gives translation and rotation; 3 pig experiments) / 2022 IJCARS 4-DOF manipulator with automated view recovery (distal and proximal units; 4 pig experiments); 2022 arXiv zero-slack separable ICE robot (debuy2022_design: reusable back portion with four Faulhaber LM 1483-080-11-C linear motors pulling the four tendons directly through 3:1 spools, disposable front portion clipped on with a twist lock and magnetic coupling; 2 bending DOF only, translation/rotation not handled; Materials and Methods, Fig. 1); 2025 arXiv tip-visibility guidance (title)
target_anatomy: intracardiac echocardiography during EP and structural-heart procedures (incl. transseptal puncture)
devices_driven: ACUSON AcuNav Volume ICE catheters (Siemens Healthineers)
translation_detail: other: proximal unit at the introducer sheath gives linear and rotational motion of the shaft (mechanism N.R.)
rotation_detail: distal unit holds the handle, turns both knobs and gives bulk rotation synchronised with the proximal unit
footprint_mm: zero-slack version: 298 mm long, 66 mm diameter (debuy2022 Fig. 1(a) dimension labels); 2020/2022 manipulator N.R.
imaging_compat: ICE ultrasound; fluoroscopy-free robot-guided transseptal punctures in animals
sterility: zero-slack version: reusable actuator back portion, disposable front portion that holds the catheter tendons (debuy2022 Introduction, Fig. 1); 2020/2022 manipulator N.R.
validation_detail: 4 animal experiments (pig, Houston Methodist MITIE) including 2 fluoro-less robot-guided transseptal punctures; beating-heart phantom (Archetype Medical) (kim2022 Sec. 3)
key_numbers: view recovery 2.09 +- 0.90 mm and 3.93 +- 2.07 deg in animals, 0.67 +- 0.79 mm and 0.37 +- 0.19 deg in phantom (kim2022 abstract); bench compensation at 60 deg bend 14.8 mm / 31.0 deg -> 5.0 mm / 10.3 deg RMSE (kim2020 arXiv); zero-slack bench, 3 sinusoid trials: tip MAE 4.80 mm / 6.11 deg, 3.31 mm / 3.26 deg with +/-10 deg hysteresis compensation (debuy2022 Table 1)
